did: Studio's Renders page now keeps an owed essay under Coming once its Monday has passed, says it is late, and says what it waits on in plain words: a refused essay, a take home couldn't hear or is still hearing, a week not made final, nothing written, or a week that never arrived. A take home couldn't hear leads to Needs your attention. The assurance ledger's EV3 promise now covers an owed essay that never reached the render worker, held by the two new overdue alerts on home. The first pull request was labelled a defect; the coordinator ruled it a story, because an earlier call chose the Tuesday drop, so the work was rebuilt as one story and the first closed.

calls.title: Keep a passed day under Coming, late, with what it waits on (C1428, moves C387)
options: Keep a passed day listed as late, with what it waits on
Drop a passed day, as C387 chose, and leave lateness to Slack alone
calls.why: Dropping it on the Tuesday made an owed essay read as a quiet week, which is what the owner said on 2026-11-24: Monday came, the essays didn't, and nothing said why.
calls.undo: On home, list an essay's Monday only while it is today or later and read two weeks again; on the phone, drop the late and waits-on lines.

left: EV3 stays unproven: the alerts are on home's rules, but no owed essay has yet gone late on home, which only home can show.

The phone's sample pictures show what the essay waits on but not the way to Needs your attention, because a real home by Monday would be waiting on a take it hasn't heard yet; a sample with a take judged in the last hour would show it, if wanted.
